name: UT ServiceNow
description: Unit tests of every ServiceNow command against the local stand-in (made-up records, made-up token from the vault): each case shows the command in use and checks its result.

variables.name: ut_dir
variables.description: Folder with the test data (files, workbooks, fixtures).

variables.name: standin_url
variables.description: Address of the local stand-in that imitates outside services.

variables.name: ut_report
variables.description: One line per case: PASS or FAIL, the command and the case.

args.title: 0. About this agent

args.text: Unit tests of every ServiceNow command against the local stand-in (made-up records, made-up token from the vault): each case shows the command in use and checks its result.

args.message: Unit test agent UT ServiceNow started

steps.description: 0. About this agent

args.title: 1. ooa.servicenow/authenticate - user and password through the OAuth registry

args.text: Authenticate gets an OAuth access token for a user (password grant) and keeps it, with the instance address, as the ServiceNow session for the next steps. Checks the token lifetime and refresh token.

children.description: Sign in to the stand-in instance

else.description: Stop the case: the check failed

args.message: the refresh token: expected notEmpty , got ${sn_refresh}

else.description: Stop the case: the check failed

args.value: ${ut_report}PASS  ooa.servicenow/authenticate: user and password through the OAuth registry

children.description: Add a PASS line to the report
Run the command and check what it gave back

args.value: ${ut_report}FAIL  ooa.servicenow/authenticate: user and password through the OAuth registry: ${ut_err}

children.description: Add a FAIL line with the reason

steps.description: 1. ooa.servicenow/authenticate - user and password through the OAuth registry

args.title: 2. ooa.servicenow/query - encoded query plus a filter, newest first

args.text: Query records returns the records an encoded query finds; filter adds field = value conditions and order_by sorts. The step has no address or sign-in: the session gives them. Checks two incidents.
